node.statement: By lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization, A=Im(tilde-Phi), with its inherited operator-space structure, is an extended epsilon_AI(eta)-C*-algebra. By lem-thmainext-conditional there are a finite-dimensional C*-algebra B and an extended delta-isomorphism v:B->A with delta=C_E*epsilon_AI(eta); moreover delta<=C_E*C_A*eta<=bar-C_E*C_A*eta=C_V*eta.
